name: Advanced Computer Architecture
description:
o Definitions
   * Performance metrics
   * Availability, reliability, fault tolerance

o Processor architecture
   * Advanced techniques of the instruction pipeline
   * Superscalar processors
   * Multicore processors

o System architecture
   * Memory hierarchy concepts and technologies
   * Hardware and compiler techniques for locality optimization
   * Bus systems
   * IO

o Architecture of parallel computers
   * Parallel applications
   * Classification
   * Shared memory systems
      - UMA, NUMA
      - Cache Coherence
      - Synchronization
   * Distributed memory systems
   * High Performance Networks
   * Parallel IO
   * Accelerators, GPGPUs

o Performance Evaluation
   * Benchmarking
   * Speedup metrics
   * Performance tools
prerequisites: Module IN0004: Introduction to Computer Organization and Technology - Computer Architecture
